ValidationRule.description: Prevent submitting the booking record for approval if there is no payment plan selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Approval_Status__c , "Pending Approval"), ISBLANK( Payment_Plan_Id__c ) , RecordType.DeveloperName ="Residential_Sales_Booking" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment Plan must be selected before submitting the Booking record for approval request.
